reverie.title: REVERIE — the apprentice and the current, learning each othe
narr: you sit in the dark of the shed where the grid lives,
her fingers tracing lines on the blueprint, soft and slow.
"force is pressure that hasn't learned to breathe," she says.
the current moves; at her touch, the grid begins to yield.
you see the moment she knew: softening is not weakness.
it is pressure that has heard itself spoken back kindly.
